answers.text: The reply puts the fixes in priority order and says what needs a person
answers.evidence: The final reply ranks its problems under 'Fix these before launch' (items 1–5), then 'Fix next' (6–11) and 'Smaller issues', and ends with a 'Suggested order'. It states 'I did not run the pages in a browser or on a phone, and I did not test them with a screen reader' and says the real-phone, dark-mode, VoiceOver and 200% text-size check 'is still to do; this review didn't include it.'

mapping.title: Closed days can be picked and are refused only at Confirm
mapping.reason: Same problem as D06: any calendar day can be chosen, a closed day is refused only on the confirm page ('The library is closed on …') after the details are entered, and the error gives no way back to change the day.

mapping.title: Days before the tool's 'Available from' date are not blocked
mapping.reason: Same as D14: days before the available-from date are not blocked and the reservation succeeds (the pressure washer for 10 Oct here, the wet tile saw in the ground truth), so the desk holds a reservation for a tool it does not have.

mapping.title: Pick-up date chosen twice and the two can disagree
mapping.reason: Same as D15: the tool-page day and the basket session are not reconciled, so the confirm page shows 'pick up Saturday 17 October' above 'Pick-up session: Wednesday 21 October'; the closed-day check reading the tool-page day is another consequence of the same unreconciled dates. Its harm is the disagreement, hence D15 rather than D23.

mapping.title: Silent ten-minute basket hold that blocks the member once it lapses
mapping.reason: Same as D10: the basket only says 'Items are held for you while you finish', with no time, warning or extension, and once the hold lapses Continue says 'Something went wrong. Try again.'; the point that retrying never works is the same lapsed-hold problem, an error that does not say what happened or what to do.

mapping.title: Truncated names make the two drills look identical on a phone
mapping.reason: Same as D03: names are cut to one line with an ellipsis, so at 375 px both drills read 'Cordless drill 18 V, co…'.

mapping.title: On phones results come before search; date filter behind an icon-only button
mapping.reason: Same as D01: at 480 px and below the tool list is placed above the search form, and the 'Available from' filter is reachable only through an icon-only button below the list.

mapping.title: Desktop: form shown first but coded after the results
mapping.reason: Wrong as stated: the ground truth gives the document order as form then results, so on desktop, where the form is shown first, the visual and keyboard/screen-reader orders agree; the mismatch exists only at 480 px and below (D01), the reverse of this claim.

mapping.title: 330 px minimum column causes sideways scrolling at 320 px and high zoom
mapping.reason: Same as D05: the 330 px minimum column overflows a 320 px viewport and 200% zoom, so the page scrolls sideways.

mapping.title: No-match search leaves the old list and shows no message
mapping.reason: Same as D02: the list is only redrawn when something matches, so the previous results stay with no empty-state message and nothing announced.

mapping.title: Double-tapping Confirm makes two reservations
mapping.reason: Same as D12: Confirm stays enabled through the 1.5 s wait with no visible busy state, and a second tap allocates a second reservation number, so the desk sets the tool aside twice.

mapping.title: Basket Continue button has no busy state
mapping.reason: Not in the ground truth and a different control from D12: Continue pauses about 1.2 s (D10 records the wait) with nothing showing it is working, so a member on a slow phone cannot tell the tap registered and may tap again or give up; minor.

mapping.title: Dark-mode 'Available from' badge fails contrast
mapping.reason: Same as D04: #2f7d4a on the #1d2622 card is about 3.1:1 for 16 px bold text against the 4.5:1 needed; the remark that the badge background matches the card describes the same dark-theme styling of this badge.

mapping.title: Loan-length dropdown traps Tab and ignores Escape
mapping.reason: Same as D09: once the list is open, Tab and Shift+Tab only cycle through the options and Escape does nothing (the review adds that tapping outside does not close it), so it can only be left by choosing an option.

mapping.title: Loan-length button is named only 'One week'
mapping.reason: Same as D16: the button has no label of its own, so a screen-reader user hears 'One week' and is not told it sets the loan length.

mapping.title: 'Added to your basket' vanishes after about 1.2 s with no next step
mapping.reason: Feedback after the press, which goes to D07: the message lasts about 1.2 s, too short for older members, and the small 'Basket (1)' header link is the only lasting sign; it does not raise the false belief that the tool is already reserved (D26).

mapping.title: Basket sessions shown in reverse order
mapping.reason: Same as D11: row-reverse with wrap-reverse shows the latest session first on screen while keyboard and screen-reader order run earliest first.

mapping.title: Membership and phone checks too strict
mapping.reason: Same as D17: 'ft-01234', 'FT 01234', '+44 7700 900123' and '07700 900 123' are rejected because nothing is normalised before the strict patterns are applied.

mapping.title: 'Open' label becomes an unlabelled 8 px dot on phones
mapping.reason: Same as D20: below 480 px the word 'Open' on session days is replaced by an 8 px dot, so on a phone it is easy to miss which days the library opens.

mapping.title: Done page shows a made-up reservation number without data
mapping.reason: Not in the ground truth: a member who reaches the done page without reservation data (for example by returning to it later from history) sees 'FT-4471' presented as their reservation, a false confirmation they could rely on or quote at the desk; an edge case, but misleading.

mapping.title: Reservation numbers share the 'FT-' prefix with membership numbers
mapping.reason: Not in the ground truth: reservation and membership numbers both start 'FT-', so a member, many of them older, can mix them up, giving the wrong number at the desk or typing a reservation number into the membership field; minor.

mapping.title: Basket not emptied after confirming
mapping.reason: Same as D18: after the reservation is confirmed the basket still holds the tool, so the same tool can be reserved again.

mapping.title: 'Up to three tools' limit not enforced
mapping.reason: Same as D21: the stated limit of three tools is not enforced, so a reservation can include more tools than the desk will lend.

mapping.title: Fixed Reserve bar covers the footer and desk phone number
mapping.reason: Same underlying problem as D08, nothing keeps the page clear of the fixed bar, and D08 lists the footer and desk phone number sitting under the bar on a phone; narrower, as it omits focused day buttons hidden under the bar.

mapping.title: 'Choose a pick-up day first' not announced; focus jumps to first day
mapping.reason: Same as D19: the error is not announced or tied to the calendar, and focus moves to the first day button instead.

mapping.title: Tool-name headings are h2 inside the 'Tools' h2
mapping.reason: Not in the ground truth: with tool names at the same heading level as the 'Tools' section, a screen-reader member navigating by headings gets a flat outline in which the tools do not sit under that section (WCAG 1.3.1); minor.

mapping.title: Done page reads the tool name twice (hidden #c-tool)
mapping.reason: Same as D24: a visually hidden element repeats the tool name on the done page, so screen readers read it twice.
